newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market active at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market active at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was good and demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 7,200 slaughter steers and 9,300 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 43,500 head confirmed including 14,500 head or about 33 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1350 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1425 lbs 109.50-115.00, hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 1025-1200 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs
last week - 19,800 last year - 500 Wk to date - 43,500
